entities.description: A large, light-colored building with vertical corrugated metal siding serves as the background. The structure features a flat roofline and a simple, industrial or utilitarian design.

A male soldier stands in the foreground wearing a tan combat helmet with a mounted accessory, dark sunglasses, and a tan tactical vest over a camouflage uniform. He holds a black assault rifle with a wooden handguard across his chest with gloved hands, wearing tan combat boots and a belt with a sidearm holster.

equipment.weapon: black assault rifle with wooden handguard

entities.description: A male soldier stands in a military stance wearing a full camouflage uniform, tactical vest, and helmet with a mounted device, holding a black assault rifle with a curved magazine across his chest. He wears dark sunglasses and tan tactical gloves, with a serious expression visible beneath the helmet brim.

equipment.weapon: black assault rifle with curved magazine

attributes.pose: standing upright, holding rifle across chest
attributes.background: light-colored vertical siding wall, gravel ground

entities.description: A male soldier stands facing forward, wearing a tan combat helmet with a mounted accessory, dark sunglasses, and a multi-camouflage uniform consisting of a tactical vest and pants. He holds a black assault rifle with a tan handguard across his chest with both gloved hands, while wearing tan combat boots and a belt with a pouch on his right hip.

A person wearing a digital camouflage military uniform and tactical gear, including a vest with pouches and a belt, stands with a rifle slung across their body. The individual is wearing tan combat boots and has a patch on their arm, with their hand raised near their head.

clothing.gear: tactical vest with pouches, belt, arm patch

entities.description: A young male soldier stands facing forward, wearing a tan combat helmet with a mounted optic, dark sunglasses, and a multi-camouflage uniform. He holds a black assault rifle with a wooden handguard across his chest with his gloved right hand, while wearing a tactical vest and tan combat boots.

entities.description: A male soldier stands in a military uniform featuring a digital camouflage pattern in shades of tan, brown, and green. He wears a matching helmet with a mounted accessory, dark sunglasses, and tan tactical gloves, with a black pouch attached to his belt.

A young male soldier stands at attention in the foreground, saluting with his right hand while wearing a tan tactical vest over a digital camouflage uniform, a helmet with a mounted device, and dark sunglasses. He has a serious expression and is flanked by other soldiers in similar attire, one of whom is holding a rifle.
